gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with LION ROCK TUNNEL ROAD and TAI CHUNG KIU ROAD and running generally in a west south-westerly direction for about 300 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R14C. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road).
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與獅子山隧道公路及大涌橋路交界處起，大致向西南偏西伸展約三百米而暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R14C 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。(註：此路將予擴建)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with CHE KUNG MIU ROAD and running from southerly to south-easterly for about 265 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R14C. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road).
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與車公廟路交界處起，由南轉向東南伸展約二百六十五米而暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R14C 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。(註：此路將予擴建)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with TAI CHUNG KIU ROAD and running in a generally south-easterly direction for about 425 metres where it terminates temporarily as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R14C. (It should be noted that there is a future extension of this road).
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與大涌橋路交界處起，大致向東南伸展約四百二十五米而暫時終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R14C 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。(註：此路將予擴建)

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street extending as a continuation of SHA KOK STREET (which was gazetted vide G.N. 1022/81) and commencing at its junction with SHA TIN WAI ROAD and running in a north-easterly direction for about 110 metres to terminate at its junction with a partially formed and un-gazetted street as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R14C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街延續沙角街（前於一九八一年第一〇二二號憲示公佈），由與沙田圍路交界處起，向東北伸展約一百一十米，至與一已部分築成但未在憲報公佈之街道交界處終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R14C 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with TAI CHUNG KIU ROAD approximately 300 metres away from SHA TIN WAI ROAD and running in a south-easterly direction for about 505 metres where it spans to terminate in an open car-parking area as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R14C.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路由與大涌橋路交界處起（距沙田圍路約三百米），向東南伸展約五百〇五米，跨越至一露天停車處終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R14C 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road extending as a continuation of TUNG LO WAN HILL ROAD (which was gazetted vide G.N. 1741/76) and running north north-easterly for about 247 metres then north north-westerly for about 105 metres then north north-easterly for about 42 metres before curving from north-westerly to west south-westerly for about 40 metres to terminate at the gate of Sha Tin North Service Reservoir as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/ST/R3A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路延續銅鑼灣山路（前於一九七六年第一七四一號憲示公佈），向東北偏北伸展約二百四十七米，再向西北偏北約一百〇五米，再向東北偏北約四十二米，然後由西北轉向西南偏西約四十米，至沙田北配水庫閘前終止，如圖則第 NTA/ST/R3A 號以粉紅色黑斜綫所示。
